title: Astrid and the Well
author: Dominic Reyes
blurb: Wendell Ishikawa, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the last resident signs the papers.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
